question: Which of the following organisations won the Forward Faster Sustainability Award 2025 for Water Resilience?

options.text: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Thermal Power Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NTPC Limited**, India’s largest integrated power utility, has been honored with the prestigious **Forward Faster Sustainability Award 2025** in the category of **Water Resilience**.
 
• The award was presented by the **United Nations Global Compact (UNGC)** Network, recognizing **NTPC**’s exceptional efforts in sustainable water management and its commitment to the **CEO Water Mandate**.
 
• This recognition highlights **NTPC**’s proactive approach toward the **Forward Faster** initiative, which aims to accelerate corporate action to achieve the **17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** by the **year 2030**.
 
• The **Water Resilience** award specifically acknowledges **NTPC**’s success in implementing **Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD)** systems across its power plants and significantly reducing its **specific water consumption**.
 
• NTPC</str
